parsed.why: No trans-specific offence, facility ban or border friction; constitutional and regional courts actively protect trans rights, hate crimes prosecuted. Official transphobic rhetoric, survey-measured discrimination (worst for trans), and unresolved custody rules hold it mid-Reduced.

Immigration ministry deports travellers perceived queer without charges; police entrap trans women via apps, using blackmail, coerced anal exams and prison sentences through morality laws. No protections, legal gender recognition closing. State-directed targeting of visitors.

No criminalisation, but no gender-identity protection, no hate-crime law, judiciary not a protection avenue; official 2018 assessment calls attitudes hostile to visibly LGBTI people, especially in the capital. Thin, stale record; latent restrictive bills.

No criminalisation and courts sometimes rule for trans people, but current reports document discrimination in public spaces and government institutions plus frequent physical and sexual harassment of visibly trans people, political hate speech, no documented remedy.

State-imposed restroom ban by birth sex is a universal institutional exposure with no working remedy, plus rising hate crimes against trans women and anti-equality institutions. Some attacker convictions and no criminalisation moderate it.
